name: hud_ui_message_destructor
description: HudUiMessage::Destructor tears down the side widget, text panel, and base widget in recovered destructor order.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; the MSVC EH destructor frame is deferred to the HUD message/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40d590 shows HudUiWidget::DestructorCore at offset 0x390, HudUiPanel::Destructor at offset 0xe0, then HudUiWidget::DestructorCore on this.
The native message destructor smoke invokes HudUiMessage::Destructor and verifies owned base/side widget images are released and ownership flags are cleared.
